name: Hastings District Council
story: Hastings District Council was using GenaMap for its Firesim wildfire simulator by 1999. The Hawke’s Bay Region GIS Forum’s 2008 account still identified Hastings as a GenaMap council.

sources.label: NZEUG GISList discussion, The future of the NZ ESRI User Group Conference, including council and Hawke's Bay regional responses
H. Grant Pearce, Review of Fire Growth Simulation Models for Application in New Zealand, Scion Client Report No. 16246
